summary: Build portfolio scorecards, prioritization models, and governance dashboards in this advanced 5-day course. Enrol today.
lede: Corporate strategy and portfolio management helps you translate strategic intent into a governed portfolio of initiatives, investments, and resource choices. This course shows you how to assess strategic fit, weigh trade-offs, prioritize initiatives, and align capital with enterprise priorities using practical approaches such as the McKinsey 7S framework, portfolio scorecards, and prioritization matrices. You will build decision frameworks, dependency maps, governance dashboards, roadmap sequences, and benefits realization templates to support clear recommendations on what to start, stop, defer, or scale. The training also develops your ability to manage incomplete data, competing sponsors, capacity constraints, budget pressure, and shifting priorities while producing portfolio outputs that can withstand executive challenge and audit scrutiny.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with strategy, investment decisions, or portfolio governance and need stronger control over enterprise priorities.
prerequisites: Advanced course level. You should have prior experience in strategy execution, business planning, PMO coordination, investment appraisal, or portfolio review processes. Familiarity with business cases, KPI reporting, initiative tracking, and executive presentation is recommended. No programming is required, but you should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, portfolio scorecards, and structured decision frameworks. Experience with multi-project environments, capital planning, or governance forums will help you apply the exercises more effectively.
